description: This file contains Python test code using pytest to test the functionality of a TypeScript project template system within a project initialization framework. It defines fixtures for creating temporary directories and mock templates, as well as test functions to verify obtaining template info, project initialization, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and content variable replacement.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for a project, including name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types, notably including 'TYPESCRIPT'.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class encapsulating initialization commands and related setup information for a project template.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class orchestrating project initialization, including loading configs, creating templates, executing scripts, and handling post-processing.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides template instances based on directory paths and manages registration of template classes.

classes.name: TypeScriptTemplate
classes.description: Template class implementing project setup routines specifically for TypeScript projects.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Returns an instance of TemplateInitInfo containing setup commands and environment info for the template.

methods.name: initialize_project
methods.description: Performs project setup using the specified project configuration, including running post-processing scripts.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits until the post-processing step completes, typically by monitoring a marker or process completion.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads project configuration from a JSON or YAML file and returns a ProjectConfig instance.
